clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 福特CEO：人类工人正在创造差异
title_lines: 人类工人正在创造差异

subtitles.en: It took us four years of hard work to be an overnight success story.
subtitles.zh: 我们花了四年努力才一夜成名。

subtitles.en: You know, it's been, it's been just an amazing culture change it for.
subtitles.zh: 这真是一次惊人的文化变革。

subtitles.en: Literally, Matt, every one of our engineers has been in the plant, every one of our supply chain teams are in our suppliers.
subtitles.zh: 实际上，每位工程师都在工厂，每位供应链成员都在供应商那里。

subtitles.en: We are paying attention to every detail. It has taken a few years to get there, but I think it's really about the culture of putting quality before profits,
subtitles.zh: 我们关注每个细节，花了几年时间，但关键是质量优先于利润的文化。

subtitles.en: before anything else. And that really is what's exciting about this.
Because now what I'm seeing is the team really focusing on learn, turn, durability.
subtitles.zh: 现在我看到团队专注于学习、转向和耐久性。

subtitles.en: So was it, your team, was it an employee, a labor issue?
subtitles.zh: 那么是团队、员工还是劳工问题？

subtitles.en: Was it, you know, technology? Did you use AI?
subtitles.zh: 是技术问题吗？你们用了AI吗？

subtitles.en: Was it factory processes? Like, can you get into specifics of how you didn't?
subtitles.zh: 还是工厂流程？能具体说说你们是怎么做到的吗？

subtitles.en: Yeah, if you, if you were to visit today, the Rouge plant where we make the F-150, Matt, what you would see is a whole control center around data and quality data.
subtitles.zh: 如果你今天去生产F-150的Rouge工厂，你会看到一个围绕数据和质量的完整控制中心。

subtitles.en: So we measure the torque of every one of our fasteners.
subtitles.zh: 我们测量每个紧固件的扭矩。

subtitles.en: We have AI tools, vision systems, but most of all, it's just all fashion hard work of our team members all working together to pay attention to the very small details
subtitles.zh: 我们有AI工具、视觉系统，但最重要的是团队成员共同努力，关注微小细节。

subtitles.en: that will make a difference between a perfectly built Ford and an OK built Toyota.
subtitles.zh: 这些细节决定了福特是完美制造，而丰田只是合格。
